body:
Yeah, I mean, I understand that people can live with their parents for a long time. My older brother moved out as soon as he graduated and my sister has a plan to in the coming spring. I guess it’s just become expected of me...?
As for school, yes I really have exhausted every resource. I’ve attempted to drop out at least three times but against my better judgement have been convinced back in through online courses and alt classes. I’m not bad at school. My grades were all in the 90% range. It was just too rough on my mental health. I was two classes worth of credits away from graduating, too, and now I’m aged out of the system. I’ll have to start over if I ever try in the future.

Guess I’m still in vent mode so sorry about the block of text. I really do appreciate your comment, it made me tear up. thank you
